title: Zephyr: B.2.3 Priority Queuing
description: Implement 4-level priority queue: P0 routing control, P1 link ACKs, P2 urgent app, P3 bulk data.
notes: Implemented and validated Zephyr four-level TX priority queue acceptance: P0 routing, P1 ACK, P2 urgent application, P3 bulk; strict priority pop/preemption; FIFO within equal priority across slot reuse and uint32 enqueue-order wrap; oldest entry eviction among equal lowest-priority candidates; invalid priority rejected atomically; existing bounded queue, deadline expiry, explicit ENOBUFS backpressure, and routing-not-starved behavior retained. Focused host Werror test: 26/26 PASS. UBSan build/run: 26/26 PASS. git diff --check PASS. Modified only tx_queue.c, tx_queue.h, and tx_queue/main.c.
close_reason: Implemented four-level priority queue with deterministic FIFO/preemption edge handling; normal and UBSan focused tests pass 26/26
